headline: OHLA returns to profit in the first half of 2026 despite New York litigation
summary: OHLA's recurring EBITDA reached 116.9 million euros in the first half of 2026, with a 6.7% margin, supported by improvement in Construction. The company returned to profit despite New York litigation.
why: OHLA is a Spanish construction and infrastructure group, and its results and litigation exposure are watched by investors in Spanish construction.
